_risk_comment: How many shares each order is for, the same engine for every stock (see src/risk/RiskEngine.hpp). FIXED_SIZE = every order is "quantity" shares, capped by max_position_size (how it traded before). The others size in $ and are capped by max_stock_percent / max_portfolio_percent of equity instead. Compare them with: ./build/app/risk_app --backtest 2025-11-03 --days 120. Tune them (grids in risk_tuning) and save the best here with: ./build/app/risk_app --tune --backtest 2025-11-03 --days 120 --test-days 60 --save
